title: Sanford Blucher - Black Shell Cordovan
description: Here at Rancourt & Co. we can definitely validate the merits of the motto "less is more" and we firmly believe that simple doesn't have to mean boring. There's something to be said for the understated yet sophisticated look of a plain toe blucher; It is timeless, elegant, and versatile. Dress the black with a tuxedo, the espresso with a navy wool suit, or the caramel with a pair of chinos. Better yet, toe the line with the beautiful color 8. For the Sanford collection we use only the finest Horween Shell Cordovan and our "watertight" leather soles for increased durability and water resistance, another example of the handcrafted attention to detail you've come to expect from Rancourt & Co.
